items.title: Definite equality of propositions implies proof irrelevance in minimal CIC
items.author: Martin Baillon; Yannick Forster; Dominik Kirst; Assia Mahboubi; Pierre-Marie Pédrot
items.source_version: FSCD2026 LIPIcs378 article5, official CC BY4.0 publisher PDF; Theorem20 and complete Theorems18/19 support p5:10, foundation/notation from section2 pp5:4-5:5
items.difficulty_reason: The author exploits an impredicative proposition U to construct a surjective self-evaluation map. Its right inverse requires case analysis on proposition equality and Hedberg uniqueness to identify the resulting equality transport; Lawvere diagonalization then forces a fixed point of negation and hence proof irrelevance. The interplay of restricted CIC elimination, transport and impredicative diagonalization exceeds routine graduate exercises; H2 is supported without counting the standard supporting theorems as separate items.
